facts: Patrick Collison is an Irish entrepreneur, investor, and philanthropist born on September 9, 1988.
He co-founded Stripe in 2010 with his younger brother John Collison, serving as its chief executive officer.
He won Ireland's 41st Young Scientist and Technology Exhibition in 2005 at the age of sixteen for creating the Croma programming language.
He co-founded the nonprofit biomedical research organization Arc Institute in 2021 with Silvana Konermann and Patrick Hsu.
He joined the board of directors of Meta Platforms in April 2025.
He married Silvana Konermann in April 2022 after meeting her at the 2004 EU Young Scientist competition.
